<p class="teaching-intro">
I teach graduate-level courses in statistics, computing, and research methodology. Course materials are openly available as interactive Bookdown books and downloadable PDFs. Students can also access hands-on R tutorials directly within RStudio.
</p>

<details class="course-install-toggle">
<summary><i class="bi bi-terminal"></i> How to install &amp; run the interactive tutorials in RStudio</summary>
<div class="install-body">

**Step 1 — Install the package from GitHub:**

```r
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
remotes::install_github(
  "kskbhat/Teaching",
  subdir = "mahe/scnpir"
)
```

**Step 2 — Launch a tutorial:**

```r
library(scnpir)
learnr::run_tutorial("unit1_r_basics", package = "scnpir")
```

> 💡 Or use the **Tutorials** pane in RStudio (top-right panel) and click **Start Tutorial**.

</div>
</details>

</div>
